d:
Sonia Gandhi ki kitab 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' men Nitish Kumar ko lekar kaee aham baten likhi gaee hain. soniya gandhi ne INDIA gathbandhan se nitish kumar ke alag hone aur CWC ki baithak se jure ghatnakram ka bhi jikr kiya hai. aakhir us baithak men kya huaa tha aur nitish kumar ko lekar soniya gandhi ne kya khulasa kiya hai?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
